description: Use this when the user asks how much the Saudi government is awarding in contracts, overall or in one sector, or how that changed over a year. Returns the Daall Government Awards Index (DGI) or one sector index: the level, awards in the last 12 months in SAR bn, the change on a year earlier, and the page url. Not for a single company, buyer or tender. استعملها لسؤالٍ عن حجم الترسيات الحكومية السعودية كلّها أو في قطاع، وتغيّرها عن سنةٍ مضت.

code.description: DGI (default) or a sector code: CAPG, CPS, SOFT, CONS, TRAN, UTIL, TELE, HLTH
